a2-review-4.R4.1 Ana's online class:
Narrator: It's Monday evening. Ana is having her online English class with Tom.
Tom: Hi Ana! How was your weekend?
Ana: Great, thanks! Look, I want to show you a photo. Paulo sent it from Alaska. In this photo, he's standing next to a lake with Carol and Maya. Above them, there are green northern lights. Aren't they amazing?
Tom: Wow! That's beautiful. So, any news?
Ana: Yes! I'm taking the TOEIC test next month. I booked it yesterday. The test starts at nine o'clock on a Saturday morning.
Tom: That's great news! I'm sure you'll do really well.
Ana: I hope so. I might be a little nervous, but I'm going to practice every day.
Tom: Good idea. Why don't we have an extra class on Thursday?
Ana: Perfect. I'll send you an email to confirm the time.
Tom: Great. Oh, guess what? Lucy is taking a gap year. She's starting at the animal shelter next week.
Ana: Really? Is she going to become a vet?
Tom: Maybe. She's thinking about changing her major. And Priya was on a podcast last week. She talked about well-being. She said she enjoys running along the lake, even in the snow!
Ana: I love listening to podcasts. Actually, I'm thinking about starting a running group at the hospital.
Tom: Nice! And did you read Paulo's article about Hannibal? It's the town where Mark Twain grew up.
Ana: Yes, he sent it to me. Hannibal is on the Mississippi, right? I'd love to take a cruise on the river one day.
Tom: Me too. How about planning a trip when you come back to the US?
Ana: Let's do it! Oh, and I'm going to send you my favorite family photo. It's the one from my father's birthday, in our kitchen.
Tom: Is that the one with Marcos's empty coffee cup?
Ana: Ha! Yes, that's the one!
Tom: OK, let's start. Look at this photo and describe it for about a minute.
